g.title: HR_OBJECTIVE
g.text: Objectives - Objectives including targets, results and assignment rules.
Reference to the Objective Plan the Objective belongs to.
States that the Objective comes from a Template.
Reference to an Objective Template the Objective should be copied from.
Whit this flag activated, the Objective will be measured/made by one Kpi only.
Shared means that the Objective targets and results are the same for all assignees.
Inherited means that each assignee will automatically receive this Objective but targets and results can be different for each of those.
Rating Scale that will be used to assig a discrete score to the Objective result.
This is the default weight for the Objective when added to an individual appraisal section.
In this field the security placeholder for the People/Asignee entity is stored. This is frozen at the time the user first created the objective.
This is the security profile that the user who created the objective had at the time of the first save.
This field indicates if the result achieved for this objective will impact the bonus payout.
This is the reference to a payout guideline in the catalogue.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_OBJECTIVETEMPLATE
g.text: Objective Template - Objective templates are examples/models that a user can start from when creating an Objective in a plan.
Objective type determines if it is qualitative or quantitative.
The rating scale is used to assess the objective using discrete values.
The category is a logical group for the objective.
Whit this flag activated, the Objective will be measured/made by one Kpi only.
This flag states if the template is still active and can be used to create objectives from it.
This flag states that this template can be used by a Manager to create/assign team objectives starting from it.
This flag states that this template can be used by an employee self service to self assign goals.

g.title: TF_PROFILE_CATALOG
g.text: When turned off, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can impersonate any active user. When turned on, users in this profile who are also eligible to use the Proxy feature can only impersonate active users included in the specified set
A set used to limit the list of users that is possible to impersonate using the proxy logon feature.
This profile is exclude from automatical assignment of default profiles.

g.text: Appraisal Objective Section Row - This entity collects the objective within an appraisal review objective section

Indicates the weighting as a percentage

description of field single metric on appraisal objective row
description of field rating scale for entity appraisal objective row
This is the numeric score that comes from a manual adjustment. By default, it is equal to the calculated score and can be changed by authorised users.
This is the score expressed as a percentage.

g.title: HR_OBJECTIVEMETRIC
g.text: Objective Metric - This entity further describes an Objective with the Kpis that it will be measured by.
Reference to the Objective the metric belongs to.
This field specifies what is the type of target, for example if it is an amount, a deadline etc.
It's the mapping between an achievement percentage and a bonus payout percentage.
description of field interpolated of entity objective metric
It's the unit of measure of the Target/Result.
When the Objective is multimetric, specifies the weight of a specific metric result when calculating the overall objective score.
When this flag is activated, the user will specify beyond the target also other intermediate achievements below or up the target.
The rating scale is used to assess the metric using discrete values.
This field contains the result of the single objective metric when the target type is numeric.
This field contains the result of the single objective metric when the target type is date.
It's the metric achievement percentage obtained from the Target and Result.
This field indicates if the result achieved for this metric will impact the bonus payout.
This is the reference to a payout guideline in the catalogue.
